title: Broken rendering because of missing affine transformations support
labels: missing or incomplete iPhone OS API
author: ciciplusplus
body: ### Describe the feature or issue. Right now toucHLE doesn't support affine transformations on the views (e.g. rotation on 90 degrees) as indicated by the following logs: ``` touchHLE::frameworks::uikit::ui_view: TODO: [0x374f9610 setTransform:CGAffineTransform { a: 1.1924881e-8, b: 1.0, c: -1.0, d: 1.1924881e-8, tx: -5.7239426e-6, ty: -480.0 }] ``` For some games it does result in the incorrect UI rendering. This issue aims to keep track of the games with such issues, so we can re-test them as soon as affine transformations are supported. - City name screen in the SimCity - Share replay screen in the SkaterNation ### By submitting this issue, I certify that… - [X] I understand that linking to, discussing or asking for pirated content is not permitted, and will lead to an immediate ban. - [X] I understand that “Abandonware” and illegal copies of free games are also pirated content.

comments.author: hikari-no-yume
comments.body: This is, at long, long last, fixed in https://github.com/touchHLE/touchHLE/commit/58773d6b49cca1b0ad54ebd1dd31452757f1b989. That took several days of hard work… ^^; Here you can see it's fixed the SimCity issue: I haven't tested any of the other games in this issue, and I can't promise they're all fixed. It's possible that some of them need support for iOS's auto-rotation/supported interface orientations feature, for which affine transform support is a prerequisite, so this still gets us closer to supporting those. :)
